artworks.title: Lesson Study on Jersey Coast
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous Gift, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art

artworks.title: Bacchus and Ariadne
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Rudolf J. Heinemann, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is an image showing two semi-abstract human figures reclining on a cloud with an additional face in the foreground. The male figure has his arm raised and the female figure is facing slightly towards the viewer. Below them, there is an additional face that seems to be part of the cloud. The drawing is done in light brown ink, capturing the interaction and movement between the figures and the clouds.

artworks.title: Two Men in Masquerade Costumes: The Earth and a Parade Helmet
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 13.5 x 14.3 cm (5 5/16 x 5 5/8 in.)
support: 14.1 x 15.2 cm (5 9/16 x 6 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: There are two abstract humanoid forms depicted in the image. The figures have large, balloon-like torsos and curving lines that suggest ripples or clouds. Atop their bodies are profiles resembling human faces, with feather-like textures rising from their heads. Their elongated limbs bend in various directions, resembling animated characters in motion. The forms resemble familiar human postures, presented in an imaginative and abstract style.

artworks.title: A Coffered Dome with Apollo and Phaeton
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray, blue,  and pink washes over black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is an ornate drawing of a domed ceiling with a central painted scene. The drawing shows an elaborately decorated ceiling with a large oval fresco at the center featuring an allegorical or mythological scene. Surrounding the central fresco are detailed patterns of coffers and floral motifs. The architectural elements include curved sections arranged in a series of arches that form a grand dome-like structure. The central artwork appears vibrant with figures in motion, set against a background suggesting sky or divine elements.

artworks.title: An Allegory in Honor of Innocent X
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 40.2 x 50.5 cm (15 13/16 x 19 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a complex allegorical scene. The image is crowded with numerous figures and symbolic elements. At the top left, there is a celestial figure amongst clouds within a semi-circular frame. Below, figures are engaged in various activities, surrounded by elements such as an angel, animals, and circular medallions and structures. The figures display a range of expressions and poses. The scene is balanced by architectural elements and depictions of nature including trees and flowing water.

artworks.title: Frederick North, Later Fifth Earl of Guilford, in Rome
artworks.medium: pastel and gouache(?) with touches of graphite on paper mounted to canvas (on strainer/stretcher)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the 50th Anniversary Gift Committee
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a full-length portrait. He is leaning on a low stone wall, with his right elbow on the wall and his left leg crossed over the right. He holds a black top hat in his right hand, resting it on the wall. The man has a calm expression, with soft eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth. His hair is styled in a powdered fashion typical of the 18th century. He is dressed in a dark blue coat with brass buttons, a white waistcoat, tan breeches, white stockings, and black shoes with bows. He is also holding light-colored gloves in his left hand. The background includes architectural elements like a broken wall and carved stone blocks with classical motifs. In the distance, there are trees and classical buildings against a blue sky with soft clouds.

artworks.title: The Garden of San Miniato near Florence
artworks.medium: watercolor and pen and black ink, heightened with white gouache, over graphite on wove paper laid down on thick, white paper
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: Sunlight pours across golden-tan colored buildings overgrown with verdant plants in this horizontal watercolor. The main two-story building is to our right on the far side of a grassy lawn. A vine creeps across its façade, and a triangular structure projects up over the front of the building, which faces away from us. A high wall extends to or left and then comes toward us. Copper-brown-leaved trees and dark green plants grow on both sides of the wall and over a shallowly peaked roof, which suggests a more substantial structure that has been lost in the growth. Slate-blue hills are glimpsed in the deep distance to the left of the wall.

artworks.title: Martin Desjardins
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 46.6 x 35.3 cm (18 3/8 x 13 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated and looking to his right. He has curly light hair, is dressed in a dark coat over a white shirt with ruffled cuffs, and has one hand on a sculptural element. In the background are heavy curtains and pillars on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Jan Maurits Quinkhard
artworks.artist: Pieter Tanje after Jan Maurits Quinkhard
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 38.8 x 28.2 cm (15 1/4 x 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated facing forward. He gestures with his right hand towards a canvas displaying another man's portrait. The seated man has a full face, curly hair, and wears a voluminous garment and a loose neck scarf. The portrait next to him depicts a man holding a palette and brushes, wearing a detailed coat. An artist's easel is visible in the background.

artworks.title: Francesco Bartolozzi
artworks.artist: Thomas Watson after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 38.1 x 28 cm (15 x 11 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. The individual is sitting with their body angled slightly to the side while their head is turned to face forward. The person has distinct features, including a pronounced nose and full lips, and dark, curly hair that falls gently around the ears and forehead. They are wearing a coat with a fur collar over a high-collared white shirt with ornate details. Their arms are crossed on what appears to be a flat surface and resting on top of folded papers. The background is a simple, neutral tone, framed in a darker rectangular border.

artworks.title: Study for The Battle of La Hogue [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a dynamic composition. The viewer's perspective seems to be from land or a low point near water. The background includes distant ships and smoky clouds. The drawing style is loose and sketch-like with expressive pen strokes. The color scheme is monochromatic, using brown ink on a cream background. The scene includes boats and figures in the water, ships with billowing sails, and smoke or explosions. More ships can be seen in the distance amidst smoke, indicating a busy and potentially combative maritime setting.

artworks.title: Study of Moses Striking the Rock and a Procession [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two separate scenes on a single sheet. On the left side, there is an abstract scene with swirling clouds or waves and indistinct figures. On the right side, there is a more structured scene with figures gathered in an architectural space, possibly a ballroom or hall. Figures are shown in a way that suggests a social or ceremonial occasion. Both sketches are outlined delicately with pencil.

artworks.title: The Ungrateful Son
artworks.medium: red chalk on brown laid paper with framing line in black ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Douglas Huntly Gordon and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art

artworks.title: The Apostles' Creed
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stephen Mazoh & Co., Inc., in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an assembly of figures in conversation within an architectural interior. The image portrays a central figure seated on an elevated platform, surrounded by a group of individuals engaged in a lively discussion. The figures are dressed in flowing robes, and their various gestures suggest an animated exchange. The setting is a room with a checkered floor, adorned with decorative elements including chandeliers hanging from the ceiling. A framed text is displayed on the wall behind the central figure. The presence of arches and detailed architectural lines enhances the composition, suggesting depth and space. The drawing captures a moment of historical or scholarly importance, conveyed through the expressive postures and concentrated attention of the gathering.

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the 50th Anniversary Gift Committee
artworks.description: The image shows a circular composition with a knight on horseback in the center. The knight is clad in armor and tilts a lance towards a dragon on the ground. A woman in elaborate clothing and a small dog stand to the left, watching the confrontation. The background features a castle with towers and battlements. The scene is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black. Fine details are shown in the brushstrokes or etching marks, defining textures in the castle stonework and dragon scales. Various plants and rocky formations complete the landscape.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.artist: Master of the Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: woodcut printed from two blocks on two sheets (joined) of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a historical scene with architectural elements, people, and animals. The scene is bustling with numerous figures engaged in various activities. There are architectural structures with archways and windows, leading into a courtyard. Many figures are gathered, some holding staffs or tools, alongside domestic animals like goats or donkeys. The style is intricate, with fine lines and detailed shading evoking textures of fabric, brick, and stonework. Above, there is a celestial detail like a star and cloud formation with figures. On the right side, there are more architectural elements, including a partially constructed building with wooden scaffolding, and a courtyard with various figures engaged in activities. The composition is detailed and dynamic.

artworks.title: Fortitude
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 14 x 89 cm (5 1/2 x 35 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person tied with chains to a large column. The person has their arms stretched around the column, with eyes closed and a serene expression. They have long, wavy hair and a halo above their head. The person is dressed in a loose garment, and there are flames at their feet. In the background, swirling lines represent smoke. The monogram "I H" is inscribed on the column. The scene is framed within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: The Healing of the Possessed Boy in a Procession of the Volto Santo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown washes heightened with white over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sydney J. Freedberg, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial procession or gathering. The image depicts a group of figures engaged in a ceremonial role, with some holding or gesturing around an ornate object. The figures are dressed in flowing robes or garments, and there is a sense of motion and interaction between them. The central figure appears to be holding or lifting an item. The gathering is framed under a canopy, suggesting formality.

artworks.title: Michel de Marolles
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Pierre Beres in memory of Lessing Rosenwald and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a finely detailed drawing of a man's upper body, positioned at a three-quarter angle, with his head turned slightly towards the viewer. His facial features are clearly defined with distinct eyes, a narrow nose, a prominent mustache, and long wavy hair that falls to his shoulders. He is wearing a collared garment with a buttoned design visible down the front. There is no visible jewelry, and he is not holding any objects. The background is plain with a neatly outlined frame forming a border around the portrait. Below the portrait, text identifies him as "MICHAEL DE MAROLLES ABB. DE VILLELOIN" with a date of "1648," along with what appears to be a coat of arms or a decorative emblem.

artworks.title: Claude de Marolles
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Pierre Beres in memory of Lessing Rosenwald and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man facing forward. He has a full beard, curly hair, and wears a ruff collar, an armor-like garment, and a sash. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background consists of fine lines and an ornate rectangular frame. Below the portrait, there is a Latin inscription. The image is set on a book page with a visible binding on the left and text from another page on the right.

artworks.title: The Discovery of the Tomb of Punchinello
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper tinted with yellow-green watercolor
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.5 x 18.3 cm (9 1/4 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher Mendez, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of individuals in a sketched style. One male figure appears partially clothed and is turned to the left, while the woman beside him is seated and has long hair. Other figures surround them, wearing robes and head coverings. The background shows rocks and a snake near some stones or logs. On the far right, an individual appears to hold a staff or rod.

artworks.title: Study after Old Master
artworks.medium: pen and ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an interior architectural space with columns and arches. The drawing features a large room with high arches, columns, stone staircases, and groups of people in various poses. Light shading adds depth to the drawing. The use of loose yet deliberate line work gives it an expressive and somewhat abstract feel.

artworks.title: Study after Domenichino
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art

artworks.title: Study after Old Master
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with their back facing the viewer. The individual is standing with their right arm slightly bent and their left hand holding a slim stick or cane. Their head is turned to the right, showing a smooth profile. They are wearing a light-colored cap with yellow cross-like patterns, a pink tunic with intricate details at the collar, white vertical stripes on the puffed sleeves, form-fitting blue hose with green and black striped patterns over the calves, a green belt at the waist, and a pink ribbon tied around the left thigh. The person is wearing flat, dark-colored shoes. The background is plain.
